note: Private common IPA 724 = the delivered 723 with RPCS3 Core 923, MeloNX Core 723, skins PR 170 and host changes. RPCS3 Core 923 (= 921 + 922 + 923): the God of War III MLAA bypass is applied to resumed savestates and is on by default for that title; the RPCS3 database is the reference for every game (a legacy full custom_configs file is no longer applied; global < RPCS3 database < the user's per-game settings; games stay at the global resolution, 100 %); the RewindBox God of War III title profile is removed; freeze dumps read reservation words next to thread times (Black Ops II freeze of build 723); one SPU region profile per boot when the SPU threads saturate the device (COREPROF SPUPROF923) and a kernel ledger memory line (COREPROF MEMPARTS923). Host: the RPCS3 performance history keeps 8 MiB per generation and the PS3 report exports its previous generation. MeloNX Core 723 (GC keep-alive dormant line, GC pause journal, separate-array dirty bit, texture array barrier epoch), bridge memory breakdown, MoltenVK 6f65b2a6 unchanged. Skins PR 170: precise pressed states on the board packs. Base: the delivered and verified 723. The database turns Asynchronous Texture Streaming on for God of War III, never run on the device. No iPhone measurement of this build; no FPS claim.
